title: Your First 1:1 as a New Manager
lessonTitle: Transitioning from Individual Contributor to Manager

checklistItems.label: Kept Claire open after the rejection (listen / respond; not push into defense or shutdown)
Agreed next presentation actions and timing
Kept ownership with Claire; did not take over the draft
Named the failed review; agreed how progress is checked before resubmit

scenarioSummary.now: First 1:1 after senior leadership rejected a client presentation Claire owned.
scenarioSummary.layers: A trust (why-budget) → B plan (confirm once) → C peer-habit hope → D check → clear close.
